answers.question: OSM platforms (5 ways) carry no refs, so lifts/stairs are not linked to perron 1 (spor 0/1) or 2 (spor 3/4); which platform each lift reaches is unsettled. OSM shows only two lifts, both 0;-1.
answers.answer: Lift n3672678538 serves perron 2 (spor 3/4) (The raw OSM platform relations do carry refs: r11143454 '0;1' and r11143455 '3;4'. n3672678538 (0;-1) lies inside 3;4, between the track 3 (6.7 m) and track 4 (6.2 m) lines, so it serves perron 2.)
